items.text: Moved our 3-bedroom house in 4 hours. The crew showed up at 8am, everything was wrapped before they touched a doorway, and we were done by noon. No surprises on the final bill.
items.author: Jennifer Martinez

items.text: Called Monday afternoon for a garage cleanout, they came Wednesday morning. Pulled out 15+ years of junk, donated what was good, and left the space completely empty. Best $800 I've spent.
items.author: Robert Chen

items.text: Cross-country move from Vegas to Portland. Quoted $4,200 flat, arrived on schedule, nothing was damaged. When we got to Portland, everything was exactly as it left. No hidden fees, no upsells.
items.author: Michelle Thompson
